newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-BRING ENGLAND TEAM HOME IN DISGRACE, SAYS MP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BRING ENGLAND TEAM HOME IN DISGRACE, SAYS MP.

text.p: A British MP called for the England cricket tour to be abandoned and the team brought home in disgrace following their latest humiliation by Zimbabwe.
Conservative MP Terry Dicks said he was "ashamed" of England's shambolic performance in the final one-day international.
England were beaten by 131 runs in Harare, losing the one-day series 3-0.
"I am ashamed of the England team," said Dicks. "I think the tour should be abandoned now.
"They should not be allowed to go out to the sun in New Zealand. They should be brought home in disgrace. I would sack the management and half the team. I have never been so ashamed to be English."
Another Tory MP, Bill Cash, said English cricket had reached a new low.
"We have got to shake the whole thing up and produce some new talent."

Former England captain Brian Close said the players wanted "their backsides kicking", while Geoff Boycott criticised England's lack of preparation for their tour of Zimbabwe and New Zealand and questioned their team spirit.
The outspoken former Yorkshire and England batsman said: "I don't call going to Portugal for a bit of golf and a bit of running about preparation for a winter cricket tour.
"We are not mentally tough. We do not produce bad cricketers but we have cricketers who too often don't perform to their best capabilities."
England leave for the second leg of their winter tour on Saturday.
